knowledge.purpose: Full-bleed page band with constrained inner max-width — the canonical wrapper for a marketing or content row
useCases: Hero — ONE section containing a badge + heading + text + buttons as inline children
Feature row — ONE section containing a heading + a grid of cards inline
Footer band — ONE section containing link groups + copyright text inline
antiPatterns: Tight inline grouping of a few blocks — use layout.container
knowledge.implementation:
Further anti-patterns:
- Scaffolding an empty section then filling it in a later step — build the section COMPLETE with its children inline in one step (an empty + filled pair renders a blank duplicate)

Further use cases:
- Visually separated content area with its own background colour

props.name: backgroundGradient
props.type: { from: string; to: string; via?: string; direction?: string; type?: "linear" | "radial" | "conic"; at?: string; angle?: number }
props.description: Themeable gradient background. Color stops are theme color roles (primary/accent/background/…) resolved to var(--pw-color-*), so the gradient follows a theme recolour. Supports linear, radial (orb/glow), and conic (angular sweep). Prefer this over a pinned block.style gradient.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Frosted-glass backdrop-blur for the section band (mirrors panel.card's glass). sm/md/lg → blur(4px|10px|20px); 'none' = no blur. Use over a gradient/image background.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: CSS aspect-ratio for the section band, e.g. '16/9', '4/3', '1/1', '21/9', '3/2', or a number. Sets the ratio without forcing a fixed height.

jsonSchema.description: The landmark this box is: header (the bar or brand), main (the page content), footer (the legal line) or aside. Unset: a plain box. Shell patterns set it; a page has one main.
